title: Big Buddha morning, optional Island tram, yum cha, Ozone, departure
cal: Big Buddha, tram optional, Ozone, fly
summary: Breakfast then out to Lantau for Ngong Ping 360 / Big Buddha morning (Crystal cabin / fast-lane options available). Optional double-decker tram on Hong Kong Island later. Then yum cha, spare window, pack, Ozone at sunset, dinner, taxi to airport. Late checkout to 18:00.

rows.detail: Then head out for Big Buddha.

Options: MTR (~40-50 min); taxi from hotel to Tung Chung terminal (~30-40 min, ~HK$220-320 incl. tolls). Cable car: Standard round-trip ~HK$295; Crystal (glass floor) round-trip ~HK$365. Crystal has shorter queues / priority boarding feel. Book on Klook or official for best rates. Fast-lane / pickup packages also available (see notes).
268 steps. Skip most of the village. Cable car back down when ready.

rows.what: Back to hotel / pool or Island tram (optional)
rows.detail: Return via MTR or taxi. Optional: Star Ferry or MTR to Central/Sheung Wan, then double-decker tram (Ding Ding) eastbound through Central → Wan Chai → Causeway Bay. Flat ~HK$3.30, upper deck. Runs late.

Three good choices, book one today. Celestial Court, 2F of your hotel: Michelin listed, no travel, Mon to Sat 11:30 to 15:00. Spring Moon at The Peninsula, ten minutes' walk: calm and refined, about HK$500 to 800 a head (est. A$91 to 145), smart casual. Maxim's Palace, City Hall, Central: the big noisy trolley hall, 11:00 to 15:00, ferry across. Most places stop dim sum about 15:00. How to order: How-to 36.
About two hours for anything missed. Central by Star Ferry, M+ and the West Kowloon waterfront, or Nathan Road.

rows.what: Back at the hotel, pack and shower
rows.detail: No rush. Ask at the desk whether checkout can go later still.
You have until 18:00. Leaving now catches the sunset at Ozone. Suitcases go to the concierge.
Short taxi to ICC, 118th floor. Sunset at 17:50, then the lights. Open from 16:00. No flip flops, and no open shoes or sleeveless tops for men.
Lei Garden in Elements, directly below Ozone: reliable Cantonese and roast meats, book by phone. Or back in Tsim Sha Tsui close to the bags.

From the hotel driveway. Show: 機場 一號客運大樓 國泰航空. 30 to 40 minutes at that hour, roughly HK$300 to 400 (est. A$54 to 73). Latest safe taxi 21:15. Backup: the Airport Express from Kowloon Station (How-to 37).

rows.what: Check in at the Cathay desks

rows.detail: Saturday 31 October, Terminal 1. Lands Melbourne Terminal 2 at 12:30.

notes: Taxi from TST/Sheraton to Tung Chung terminal: ~30-40 min, ~HK$220-320 incl. tolls (urban red taxi). MTR is cheaper/reliable. Crystal Cabin round-trip ~HK$365 (glass floor, shorter queues); Standard ~HK$295. Book online (Klook or official webstore.np360.com.hk) for better rates and priority. Fast-lane / hotel-pickup packages exist on Klook (group coach from central TST points like Holiday Inn Golden Mile).
After returning from Lantau: Star Ferry or MTR to Central/Sheung Wan, then Ding Ding tram eastbound for the classic ride. Flat fare ~HK$3.30.
A taxi at 21:15 puts you at the airport by 22:00, which is 2.5 hours before departure.
If Friday is wet or grey
Skip the pool. M+ and the West Kowloon waterfront is the indoor option, and the room is yours until 18:00. Cable car may close in high winds.
